verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Windsurf control a browser, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. The axis applies because the product explicitly ships an MCP server mode. Missing for 10: detail on the exposed tool set and setup/auth configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
